keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «엄마의 말: 기다려 보렴(교훈)» 과 «노란 꽃이 핀다(결과)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the lesson (Mom says, "Wait and see") and the result (a yellow flower opens). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Wait and see. Do not give up.

qs.q: Why does Hana want to give up?
evs: Hana plants a little seed in a pot.
One morning, she sees a small green leaf.
A few weeks later, a pretty yellow flower opens!
why: «After one week, nothing happens.» 일주일이 지나도 아무것도 자라지 않아서 포기하고 싶었어요.
After one week, nothing happens, so Hana wants to give up.

qs.q: Mom says, "Wait and see." What does she mean?
qs.qko: 엄마가 «Wait and see.» 라고 말해요. 무슨 뜻일까요?
opts: Be patient, and the seed will grow.
evs: A few weeks later, a pretty yellow flower opens!
Hana plants a little seed in a pot.
why: «A few weeks later, a pretty yellow flower opens!» 기다렸더니 꽃이 피었으니, 참고 기다리면 자란다는 뜻이에요.
A few weeks later, a flower opens, so Mom means be patient and the seed will grow.

qs.q: How does Hana's seed become a flower?
opts: She keeps watering it and waits.
evs: Hana wants to give up, but Mom says, "Wait and see."
Hana plants a little seed in a pot.
why: 엄마가 기다려 보라고 했고(«...Mom says, "Wait and see."»), 하나는 계속 물을 주었어요(«Hana keeps watering the pot.»).
Mom says to wait, and Hana keeps watering the pot.

ends: Hana plants more seeds with her friends.
Hana gives her yellow flower to Mom.

write.src: “I want to <u>plant a seed</u> because <u>I like flowers</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «하고 싶은 일 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what you want to do and your reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because my mom likes flowers)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because my mom likes flowers)
